summary: Frontend testing of the new Lux Horoscope page with Mestre Agnes-style zodiac grid and pop-ups. Age gate passed, /bem-estar/horoscopo renders zodiac-widget with the 12 western sign cards (illustrated art) and 12 chinese sign cards (with glyph). Aries pop-up (sign-horoscope-dialog) opened, reading loaded from /api/horoscope/agnes in ~10s and displayed essence + Overview/Love/Career/Advice sections, lucky numbers, lucky color, Agnes badge, and CTA button. Switching to Touro updated the dialog title. Chinese Dragão dialog (chinese-zodiac-dialog) opened, showed years chips, reading, and Agnes badge. Compatibility card produced a result with score. Personal reading section and partner-card-mestre-agnes visible.

issues: Radix warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — add a DialogDescription (or aria-describedby=undefined explicitly) for a11y compliance.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add a <DialogDescription> to AgnesSignDialog and AgnesChineseDialog to silence Radix warnings.

(Optional consistency) The `data-testid` on Section (sign-section-<label>) uses the translated label (e.g., 'Overview' vs 'Panorama'). Consider using stable English keys (overview/love/career/advice) so tests don't depend on active locale.
critical_code_review_comments: Section data-testid pattern (sign-section-${label}) is locale-dependent; brittle for automation. Prefer stable slugs.
AgnesSignDialog/AgnesChineseDialog lack DialogDescription — a11y warning in dev console.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Horoscope page fully validated with EN locale. The GET /api/horoscope/agnes call for western signs responded in ~10s (well under the 60s expected cold start). All data-testids match the spec. Only cosmetic a11y warnings and a locale-dependent section testid remain.
